prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu heritage monument line plate. Image 1 is a documentary photograph of the ACTUAL Kannon-den (Silver Pavilion) at Jisho-ji, Kyoto; use it for subject geometry. Draw the complete extant two-storey Silver Pavilion in a gentle three-quarter view as in photo: wide lower storey with plain wall/sliding panels, smaller upper storey with characteristic windows, dark wood rail and broad traditional Japanese roofs. It is NOT coated in silver, and must not resemble the three-storey Golden Pavilion. Exclude trees, pond reflection, sand garden, tourists and all adjacent buildings except a few light base lines. Elegant sparse BLACK contour lines on perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas. Landscape framing with complete roof and base, generous blank margin. No shadows, gradients, gray wash, crosshatching, paper grain, glow, checkerboard, transparency, writing, labels, frame or watermark.
